title: Test Gap: traffic between port channels on different asics when SWSS restarts
author: peterbailey-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the test gap

We have seen regressions where traffic between portchannels on different asics fails when swss restarts.
test coverage needed

### Affected Area

sonic-swss

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

without the test we might see traffic drops on multi asic systems.

New test added to cover the problem seen in issue 27283 caused by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/3553

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Add a new test case for portchannel updates.

#### How did you do it?
The test verifies inter-asic traffic after SWSS restarts.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran the test on a multi asic pizza box, using an image with and without the fix that resolves https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/27283 
to see that it currently fails but then passes with that fix.

Thank you to @arista-hpandya for also helping with the test and verification.
